policy.negativeEvidence: Failure to find a numeric rule does not prove impossibility; unsupported numeric interactions stay neutral until an explicit calibration is supplied.

policy.assumptions: User explicitly authorizes reasonable size assumptions for the remaining race/subrace profiles. Store support/center/body-form/metric and assumption label; no additional approval needed for these normal-form defaults.
policy.crossMetricComposition: Explicit per-profile principal-dimension projection at scale1 to characteristic-dimension, used only for mixed-metric composition. This compares declared body extents for the fantasy design, not physical equality of measurements. Missing/mismatched projection still requires an explicit body profile.
policy.manifestations: AI/Ghost/Elemental/Primordial abstract profiles measure rendered avatar/swarm envelope; no physical mass, damage, actual storm, planet or universe assigned from display size.

compositionMetricPolicy.authority: User permits authored Size assumptions for remaining identities and compositions. Only profiles explicitly declaring their source metric and scale1 may participate.
compositionMetricPolicy.interpretation: Mixture uncertainty about dominant normal-form principal dimension; not multiplying simultaneous body measurements or asserting a real-world height/length equivalence.

probabilisticContract.formula: P(size|context) ∝ P_prior(size)^priorStrength × product(P(context_group|size)^effectiveStrength) × explicit factors; normalize on hard-eligible support.
probabilisticContract.modelClass: Discrete conditional Bayesian/tempered likelihood model; strength1 is the declared ordinary Bayesian update. Lore likelihood parameters are authored, not validated probabilities of real-world observations.
probabilisticContract.raceComposition: One specific prior per owned body identity; mixture over the same metric or explicit per-profile principal-extent projection for mixed metrics. Explicit all-source body profile wins; no hidden Human fallback.
probabilisticContract.mixtureFormula: P_prior(size) = sum(normalizedRaceInfluence_j * P_j(size)); union of whole-number supports, no multiplying contradictory absolute-body densities.
probabilisticContract.dependencies: Subtype already encoded in selected prior is not treated as an independent observation again. One most-specific rule per dependency group; equal-specificity ties need configuration. Explicit interaction=true is a conditional joint correction, not a duplicate independent clue.
probabilisticContract.evidenceScope: Canonical committed owner family/results/Archetype IDs only. External troops/prey/mentors/equipment and future uncommitted spins are not context evidence.
probabilisticContract.display: Condition the full finite candidate distribution first, then approximate at most12 readable whole-number sectors by posterior quantiles/nearest bins. Sum assigned mass; preserve full posterior and projection mapping. Single12-point profile remains unchanged.
probabilisticContract.equalizer: Override final displayed hard-eligible sectors to uniform; suppress soft lore bias, preserve physical support/guards.
probabilisticContract.numerics: Log-space likelihood normalization avoids product underflow; reject contradictory all-zero likelihood unless Equalizer suppresses soft bias.
probabilisticContract.giant: Raksasa fixes abnormal support of eight milestones. Default prior1/8; only explicitly scoped giant evidence/factors can change odds. Initial lore rules are normal-only.
probabilisticContract.calibration: Selected lore centers and explicit user-authorized normal-form intervals for complete current identity coverage. Broad widths, mixture/conditional strengths and principal-extent projection remain authored; not empirical population probabilities.
probabilisticContract.freeze: Save context sources, all component priors, model/version/parameters, applied/skipped rules, full posterior, display projection and final odds before one external draw; no reroll or model update on replay.
probabilisticContract.legacy: probabilityModel:null deliberately selects archived-style range planning; committed0.2 plans continue resolving unchanged.
